Get started with Docker Compose to run TaktX locally. The default lightweight configuration includes Kafka, Kafka-UI, Grafana and Prometheus for metrics and the TaktX engine itself. 

 

Run TaktX with Docker Compose

To start a complete TaktX environment locally:

  1. Download the artifact for TaktX Docker Compose, then extract it.

  2. In the extracted directory in a terminal, run:

    docker compose -f docker-compose-full.yml up -d
  3. Wait for the environment to initialize. Monitor the logs to ensure all components start. 
    # show the running containers
    docker     ps
    # Show the log of each container
    docker logs -f [Container id or name of the container]

The default docker compose file will start the following components:

  • Kafka for our persisted messages
  • Kafka UI, manage the Kafka topics
  • Grafana / Prometheus for metrics. It has a preconfigured dashboard
  • The Taktx engine
  • The console UI to monitor and manage your process instances

After the application has started succesfully you should see several topics being created in Kafka-UI. These topics are what drives the TaktX BPMN engine. All state is persisted in these topics. 

Note: this docker compose file does not employ any authentication/authorisation so it is not recommended to run this in a production-like environment. Also it will not scale, for full scalability we will need an actual Kafka cluster and a separate set of Engine nodes
